chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, dari Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, dari Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Mithami, dari Aban, dari Abu Al-Mithami, dari Aban, dari Abu Al-Abbas dan 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abdillah, yang berkata:
Kami mendengar Abu Abdillah (semoga Allah meridhainya) berkata: 'Hak syuf'ah tidak berlaku kecuali bagi sekutu yang belum dibagi (bagiannya).'

key_terms.الشُّفْعَةُ: Pre-emption (hak opsi pertama dalam kepemilikan bersama properti)

ai.seo_question: Kapan hak pre-emption berlaku dalam hukum kemitraan Islam?
ai.summary: Hadith from al-Kafi delineates the precise temporal boundary for the right of pre-emption (shuf'ah), restricting it to partners prior to the formal division (qismah) of jointly owned property. In Shia jurisprudence, this ensures that a partner can acquire the share of another before it becomes distinct and alienable, thereby preserving the integrity of the co-ownership structure. The narration highlights the importance of timing in property transactions, a key principle in resolving disputes among co-owners.
